purpose: Offline smoke check of YOLO class detection and persistent tracker IDs. This is not camera accuracy or OP3 runtime evidence.
procedure: For each listed VAL image, call YOLO.track(source=frame, persist=True) four times on the same decoded frame. The tracker keeps one model instance across calls.

results.result: class detected; ID stable across repeated static frames
class detected; ID assigned after tracker confirmation and stable thereafter
class detected; ID assigned after tracker confirmation and stable thereafter

limitations: The inputs are static validation images repeated in software, not frames from the physical OP3 camera.
This is a smoke check, not a representative tracking benchmark and not an accuracy estimate.
No servo_idle or walking test was performed.
The lap package was installed only under /tmp/kd_lap_only for this check; the OP3 runtime must install the pinned requirement in its dedicated virtual environment.
